tests.name: R46 a leg on a typed passage counts at the passage's grade: checked typing (C) and unchecked typing (D) read D naming the unchecked typing; after its check, C; never B for a typing
R47 the method's new version names the typed-passage rule; earlier versions keep their words; a stored pair recomputes at its own version
notice leg-earning:138 (its R18, R19, R10): a typed leg stating no letter is graded by the record, not inert; stating A it reads the typing's grade with why; a weaker letter stands

not_verified: Stored version legs (versionStrength, R9) carry no content row, so a typed leg in a stored version keeps its stored grade (R46's control); a version written from a typed leg stating no letter stays inert there, and no requirement here says otherwise. testimonyCorroboration's own leg read does not apply the typed grade when judging what bears an anonymous leg out (R30, R34): the walk does. A typed leg stating a grade on another axis keeps that axis and gets no capture member. case-checker's program.mjs was already stale at HEAD and is rebuilt by its owner (now also for method.mjs's bio-grading/5). Not run: other modules' suites.
